name: official_train_checkpoint_cpu_v1
purpose: Before any official full-training launch, verify unmodified training configuration, meta-architecture parameter counts and raw recoverable-checkpoint storage under current budgets.
allowed: Read pinned released code/config and existing base-model metadata
Construct actor and original critic architecture only on meta device; no tensor weights loaded
One scalar CPU AdamW fixture to inspect moment dtypes
forbidden: Discard optimizer recovery requirements to fit budget
Declare actual GPU memory or throughput from CPU analysis
training_route: CODE_AS_RELEASED non-cold-start; restore original batch128/mini32, GAE, actorlr1e-6,criticlr1e-5,fullgenerated loss,online skills,self-distill and original train/val.
decision: If standard complete checkpoint exceeds either limit, mark original full-training checkpoint plan unready, prepare specific budget/retention alternatives for human review; no automatic full-training dispatch. Any throughput canary needs its own fixed engineering protocol and cannot count as 300-step reproduction.
